topic: What antenna designs balance aerodynamic constraints with MIMO requirements for high-speed aircraft communication?
consensus_response: Phased array antennas with adaptive beamforming and dual-polarized designs optimize performance, mitigating interference and enhancing signal-to-noise ratio. Compact modular apertures adapt to varying inter-satellite distances or transfer rates, ensuring reliable data transmission while minimizing drag.
reference_context: Antenna specifications are critical for inter-satellite communications, considering mission requirements, space environment, and cost.
